title: SIS Test · Nightly Subsystem Report
description: Twenty environment-specific checks with bounded latest-run messages, semantic status indicators, and daily result history. The bar chart covers a rolling 28-day window.

options.content:
Green = passed; red = failed; amber = stale, missing, or not configured. Bars show each day's latest result, with today on the right. Prometheus retains 28 days; older history was not kept and will fill over time.

Test: 10 authenticated workflows plus 10 vendor/configuration checks. Core groups run every 60s, parent profile every 15m, five workflows every 5m, and the no-send suite nightly at 04:00 ICT.

panels.title: Engagement

targets.expr: label_replace(max by (code) (sis_keepalive_check_failure_info{environment="test",group="engagement",code="none"} == 1), "run_message", "LAST RUN PASSED", "code", ".*") or label_replace(max by (code) (sis_keepalive_check_failure_info{environment="test",group="engagement",code!="none"} == 1), "run_message", "LAST RUN FAILED · $1", "code", "(.+)")

panels.description: Shows the latest bounded monitor outcome. Workflow messages use the monitor's bounded failure category; vendor and live probe messages show the current semantic result.

panels.title: STATUS

targets.expr: (max by () (sis_keepalive_check_success{environment="test",group="engagement"}) and on () (time() - max by () (sis_keepalive_check_last_check_timestamp_seconds{environment="test",group="engagement"}) <= max by () (sis_keepalive_check_stale_after_seconds{environment="test",group="engagement"}))) or on () vector(-1)
